statement: Either side quotes its own funds for the other's: `offer` names a maker, a give leg and a want leg in two different tokens (same_token), amounts in 1..MAX_AMOUNT, a slot of its own among the quotes and offers (offer_exists), a deadline in range (N2) and a quote to spare (R-SWAP-CONSENT). Only the maker's give is reserved, against the maker in its token and only if its RCPAN still holds; the quote reserves nothing of the taker's and is no clause of the signed body.
source: Arthur 10-01 02:53 (D3: two-party swap inside an Account); plan/swap-onchain.md; coordinator 10-01
